description: Perform a database schema migration by executing the given SQL on a temporary branch for safety, ready to complete onto the main branch.

branchId.description: Optional ID of the branch to migrate; the temporary branch is created from it and completion applies the migration back to it. When omitted, the project's default branch is used.

databaseName.description: Optional name of the database to migrate; when omitted, the project's default database is used.

migrationSql.description: The migration SQL to test on a temporary branch before it is applied to the original branch.

projectId.description: ID of the Neon project that owns the database to migrate.

name: prepare_database_migration
